messages:
sasha: Quick sync — we're seeing divergent metadata shapes land in traces. some services send just service+env, others add 10+ biz keys. feels like a garden path: starts small then explodes. thoughts?

mike: yeah noticed for billing attribution this week — query cardinality exploded. :grimacing:

priya: two obvious cores: (1) attribution keys we need for cost bucketing, (2) high-cardinality app tags for debugging. we should separate guarantees.

ian: +1. propose we define: anchor_keys = stable set for billing (tenant, org_id, payment_bucket) and extended_tags = opt-in freeform. anchor_keys contract enforced at ingest.

devon: how do we enforce at edge? have agent libraries validate and drop unknown anchor_keys? or accept and map into extended_tags?

priya: agent-side best-effort validation + ingest gating. if anchor_keys missing -> reject with 400 and observability warning. if extra keys -> route to extended_tags stream.

mike: concern: many SDKs won't upgrade fast. rejecting could break. can we fallback: accept but synthesize a _missing_anchor flag and emit a metric?

ian: yes, staged rollout: day0 = soft-annotate (accept + metric + log), day7 = warn in console, day30 = enforce reject for orgs on strict mode.

obs-bot: [automation] Created RFC draft: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/obs-anchor-keys (PR #412) — includes migration script and sample queries.

sasha: example envelope (proposal):
```
{
  "trace_id": "...",
  "span": {...},
  "anchor_keys": {"org_id":"123","tenant":"acme","billing_bucket":"platform-prod"},
  "extended_tags": {"feature_flag":"exp-x","region_detail":"az-3b"}
}
```

priya: that shape lets us keep low-cardinality indices for billing while still storing rich context in a cheaper append-only store.

mike: query ergonomics? will analysts need to join across two stores?

ian: we can expose a unified query layer that materializes anchor_keys as primary attributes and allows ad-hoc joins to extended_tags only when needed. default dashboards use anchor_keys.

devon: rollout checklist idea:
- agent validation libs (js/py/go) with feature gate
- ingest soft-annotate & metric
- console warnings + docs
- enforcement toggle per-org
- migration backfill tool for historical traces

sasha: one more: sampling. we must ensure sampled traces keep anchor_keys even if we drop spans. sampling should sample at trace-level after anchor enrichment.

priya: agree — enrich before sampler. otherwise attribution is lost.

mike: ok next step: priya / ian draft a migration playbook. devon implement agent PR. i'll wire up billing dashboards to expect anchor_keys and emit alerts if missing >1% of traces.

sasha: perfect. thanks all. meeting in 30 if anyone wants to pair on the RFC.
